raw.title: Frantz Fanon
raw.extract: Frantz Omar Fanon was a French psychiatrist and political philosopher from Martinique, who made critical contributions to the fields of post-colonial studies and critical theory. As well as an intellectual, Fanon was a political radical and Pan-Africanist, concerned with the psychopathology of colonization and the human, social, and cultural consequences of decolonization.
